title: Grateful Dead Live at Golden Hall - San Diego Community Concourse on 1970-08-05
venue: Golden Hall - San Diego Community Concourse

ai_review.summary: Acoustic summer‑70 gospel set captured on primitive tape with hiss and a baffling drum‑track mismatch; the performance is uneven but historically interesting.
ai_review.review: The recording offers a rare acoustic, gospel‑flavored Dead show from 1970, but the sound suffers from heavy hiss, cloudy tape quality and a right‑channel that seems to carry an entirely different drum mix, making Mickey’s drumming sound “horrible.” While a few listeners appreciate the unusual setlist, most note the poor audio fidelity and sub‑par percussion, resulting in a mixed listening experience.

ai_rating.rationale: Three reviews with divergent star ratings (2, 3, 5) and consistent criticism of audio quality and drumming lead to a low‑average rating; the show’s uniqueness provides some positive points but does not outweigh technical flaws.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Hissy, cloudy tape typical of early ’70 live recordings; right channel appears to have a completely different drum track causing confusion; overall primitive fidelity but still listenable with EQ adjustments.

show_quality.setlist_flow: An unusual acoustic gospel set that deviates from standard Dead setlists; the flow feels odd to many listeners and is hampered by the mismatched drum mix.

band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey's drumming described as horrible and seemingly out of sync; right channel contains a different drum track altogether.
